values.note: Sewer at some sites; most electric up to 50 amp.

values.note: 35 RV sites, 2 rustic cabins, 4 walk-in tent sites and 1 group site.

sites.source: https://ci.peshtigo.wi.gov/badger-park/ ('A 42 site campground'; '35 campsites and 2 cabins'; '4 rustic tent sites'; '1 group site (up to four campers)'); layout PDF

values.note: Passport America: 50% off Sunday-Thursday nights on a space-available basis, not on monthly stays. Active military and veterans: 10% off.

discounts.source: https://ci.peshtigo.wi.gov/badger-park/ ('PA rate is 50% off our regularly published rates and will only apply on Sunday through Thursday Evenings on a Space Availability basis'; 'Active Military and Veterans will receive a 10% Discount on camping rates.')

note: City of Peshtigo campground in the southwest corner of the 60-acre Badger Park, a short walk from downtown; the park's Peshtigo River frontage, boat and kayak launch and woodland trails lie east and north of the camping loop. --Claude
summary: City page, brochure and layout read; Firefly booking confirmed. 35 W/E RV sites (some sewer, most up to 50A) + 2 cabins + 4 walk-in tent + 1 group = 42. $35/$40; Passport America 50% Sun-Thu and 10% military. Waterfront riverview -> not waterfront (river ~190-230 m east, behind ball fields and trees). Pin at the school, ~230 m south of the loop.
flags: WATERFRONT riverview -> not waterfront (downgrade). Esri imagery: the camping loop (sites 1-37, about 45.0604,-87.7517) is enclosed by woods; the Peshtigo River lies ~190-230 m east-southeast (about 45.0598,-87.7488), beyond Emery Ave/the park road, the ball fields and the stadium, with a tree band along the shore. No site sees the water across open ground; the river frontage belongs to the day-use part of the park.

PIN: stored 45.0584,-87.7514 sits on the Peshtigo school building south of the park road; the camping loop centre is about 45.0604,-87.7517 (~230 m north; brochure GPS '4.060072,-87.751042', a typo for 45.060072,-87.751042, is the registration area). Under 250 m, but recommended since the stored point is on a school.
SEASON: city page says 'During May-October'; the 2025 brochure says 'Open Mid April – end of October'. Stored derived 05-01..10-31 kept; no season group written.
PHONE 715-582-4321 confirmed (campground, May-October 9 am-9 pm); city hall is (715) 582-4322.
WEBSITE https://ci.peshtigo.wi.gov/badger-park/ confirmed live; suggest adding the Firefly booking link https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/Badgercampground.
